NHT_VALID_DEFAULT_VRF.desc: Configure neighbor tracking for default VRF with IPv4.

NHT_VALID_USER_VRF.desc: Configure neighbor tracking for a user-defined VRF (Vrf_blue).

NHT_VALID_IPV6.desc: Configure neighbor tracking for default VRF with IPv6.

NHT_INVALID_AFI.desc: Using an AFI value outside the ipv4/ipv6 enum.

NHT_INVALID_TRACKING_VALUE.desc: Using a neighbor_tracking value outside the true/false boolean.

NHT_VALID_MULTI_ROW.desc: Four NEXTHOP_TRACKING rows validate together (cartesian product of VRFs and AFIs).

NHT_VALID_TRACKING_OMITTED.desc: Omitting neighbor_tracking leaf uses the default value (false).

NHT_VALID_RESOLVE_VIA_DEFAULT_ENABLED.desc: Explicitly enable resolve_via_default for default VRF with IPv4.

NHT_VALID_RESOLVE_VIA_DEFAULT_IPV6.desc: Configure resolve_via_default for default VRF with IPv6.

NHT_VALID_RESOLVE_VIA_DEFAULT_OMITTED.desc: Omitting resolve_via_default leaf uses the default value (true); only list keys are set.

NHT_VALID_BOTH_FIELDS.desc: Configure neighbor_tracking and resolve_via_default together in the same row.

NHT_INVALID_RESOLVE_VIA_DEFAULT_VALUE.desc: Using a resolve_via_default value outside the true/false boolean.

NHT_DUPLICATE_KEY.desc: Duplicate (vrf_name, afi) key violates list uniqueness.
